title: 第25章  一日登基一日灭国第26章  永恒的回响
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
聆听着海拉的讲述，眼前的画面也随之变化。
天穹之上一道裂缝毫无预兆地出现，一双猩红、暴戾的眼眸静静注视着下方被烈火焚烧的亚特兰蒂斯，嫣红的鲜血在地面上流淌，将大地染成了血红色，亚特兰蒂斯的子民在绝望地啼哭、哀嚎、逃跑、反抗，但一切都是徒劳无功，最终都被突然出现的火焰吞没。
“吾想拯救他们，亦想拯救亚特兰蒂斯，但吾做不到，只能眼睁睁看着这一切。”
海拉的讲述还在继续，而画面也在此时切换。
一道持剑的身影冲向天际，向着天际的猩红色眼眸斩出了一剑，但却被无形的力量束缚在半空，无法动弹亦无法挣脱，只能眼睁睁地看着亚特兰蒂斯沉入海底。
直到亚特兰蒂斯彻底沉入于海中，半空中的身影才被火焰所吞没，向着海面坠落。
“在吾生命的最后一刻，吾舍去了身躯，以血脉为引，万千子民的恨意为源，点燃复仇之火，投身于那只妖兽的力量中，化为妖兽，沉眠于亚特兰蒂斯中，等待一位被亚特兰蒂斯所选中，能承接吾之意志之人。”
话音落下，海拉左边的眼眸悄然化为紫色，暴戾、毁灭的气息，从海拉的左侧出现，和右侧的优雅高贵的气质，形成了鲜明的对比。
“那个……”
感受着海拉的变化，以及仿佛能让人窒息的毁灭气息，夜离殇刚刚开口，想要说些什么，就见海拉看了过来。
“汝刚才说过，要承接吾之意志。”
“现在可是要出尔反尔？”
海拉的语气十分平静，但左眼中的暴戾却愈发明显起来。
“我没有那个意思，我就是想问问，曾经毁灭亚特兰蒂斯的东西是什么，毕竟，知己知彼，百战不殆，而且既然要承接您的意志，自然要清楚敌人究竟是谁。”
夜离殇连忙开口。
现在的海拉看着就有点不对劲。
但想想海拉刚才所说的经历，夜离殇感觉也是能够理解的。
一日登基，一日灭国。
刚刚成为亚特兰蒂斯的女皇，亚特兰蒂斯就彻底覆灭了，这个冲击着实有点大。
“吾不知。”

“吾未曾见过它的真容，但只要它出现，吾是能感应到的。”
海拉轻轻摇头，左边的眼眸逐渐恢复正常，暴戾和毁灭的气息，也消失不见。
“那您现在和那只妖兽孰强孰弱？”
夜离殇问出一个非常关键的问题。
“嗯……吾不是它的对手。”
海拉再次轻轻摇头。
闻言，夜离殇陷入沉默。
敌人究竟是谁，还不知道。
海拉的实力怎么样，夜离殇也不知道，但从海拉散发而出的气息来看，海拉的实力肯定非常恐怖，而海拉都打不过的敌人，那毫无疑问，更加恐怖了。
但无论敌人的实力有多恐怖，海拉的意志她也必须要承接。
就现在这个情况，别说承接的意志了，就算挂海拉的鱼鳍上，当一个挂件，夜离殇都没有意见。
至于未来的敌人，那就以后再说吧。
海拉带着夜离殇往王座后面走去，在来到王座的后面时，只见一柄湛蓝色的长剑插在地面上。
海拉将夜离殇放在地上，伸手指了指长剑，无比认真的说道：“要承接吾的意志，就要拔出吾生前留下的佩剑，成为亚特兰斯的王储。”
“从此一人之下，万人之上。”
夜离殇嘴角一抽，有些无语的看着面前的长剑。
成为亚特兰蒂斯的王储，一人之下，万人之上？
她感觉也就是那个一人之下是真的，至于万人之上什么的，亚特兰蒂斯都已经覆灭了，如今就只剩下一个海拉，哪里来的万人之上。
content_en:
Listening to Hela's narration, the picture in front of her also changed.
A crack appeared in the sky without warning, and a pair of scarlet, violent eyes stared quietly at Atlantis, which was burned by the fire below. Bright red blood flowed on the ground, dyeing the earth blood red. The people of Atlantis were crying, wailing, running away, and resisting in despair, but everything was in vain, and they were eventually engulfed by the sudden flames.
"I want to save them and I want to save Atlantis, but I can't do it. I can only watch all this."
Hela's narration continued, and the screen also switched at this time.
A figure holding a sword rushed towards the sky, and slashed a sword into the sky's scarlet eyes. However, it was restrained in mid-air by an invisible force, unable to move or break free, and could only watch Atlantis sink to the bottom of the sea.
It wasn't until Atlantis completely sank into the sea that the figure in mid-air was engulfed in flames and fell toward the sea.
"At the last moment of my life, I gave up my body, used my blood as a guide, and the hatred of thousands of people as a source, ignited the fire of revenge, threw myself into the power of the monster, turned into a monster, and slept in Atlantis, waiting for a person chosen by Atlantis to inherit my will."
After the words fell, Hela's left eye quietly turned purple, and a violent and destructive aura appeared from Hela's left side, forming a sharp contrast with the elegant and noble temperament on the right.
"That..."
Feeling the changes in Hela and the aura of destruction that seemed to be suffocating, Ye Lishang just opened his mouth to say something when Hela looked over.
"You just said that you would inherit my will."
"Are you going to go back on your word now?"
Hela's tone was very calm, but the violence in her left eye became more and more obvious.
"I didn't mean that. I just wanted to ask what was the thing that destroyed Atlantis. After all, if you know yourself and the enemy, you will never be defeated in a hundred battles. And since I want to inherit your will, I naturally have to know who the enemy is."
Ye Li Shang spoke quickly.
Something is wrong with Hela now.
But thinking about the experience Hela just mentioned, Ye Lishang felt that it was understandable.
One day he ascended the throne, and the other day he destroyed the country.
Just after she became the Queen of Atlantis, Atlantis was completely destroyed. This shock was really big.
"I don't know."
"I have never seen its true appearance, but as long as it appears, I can sense it."
Hela shook her head gently, and the left eye gradually returned to normal, and the aura of violence and destruction disappeared.
"Then who is stronger or weaker between you and that monster now?"
Ye Lishang asked a very crucial question.
"Well...I'm no match for it."
Hela shook her head slightly again.
Hearing this, Ye Li Shang fell into silence.
It is not yet known who the enemy is.
Ye Lishang didn't know what Hela's strength was, but judging from the aura emanating from Hela, Hela's strength must be very terrifying, and enemies that Hela couldn't defeat were undoubtedly even more terrifying.
But no matter how terrifying the enemy's strength is, she must inherit Hela's will.
In the current situation, not to mention the will to take over, even if it is attached to Hela's fin and used as a pendant, Ye Lishang has no objection.
As for future enemies, let’s talk about that later.
Hela took Ye Lishang to the back of the throne. When he came to the back of the throne, he saw a blue long sword stuck on the ground.
Hela put Ye Lishang on the ground, pointed at the sword, and said very seriously: "If you want to inherit my will, you must pull out the sword I left behind during my lifetime and become the crown prince of Atlantis."
"From now on, one person is inferior and ten thousand people are superior."
Ye Lishang twitched the corner of his mouth and looked at the sword in front of him speechlessly.
Becoming the crown prince of Atlantis, under one person, ten thousand peopleAbove people?
She felt that it was true that one person was more powerful than one person. As for being more powerful than ten thousand people, Atlantis had been destroyed. Now there was only one Hela left. How could it be that it was more powerful than ten thousand people?
